governing_spec.section: Residual F07: Packaged Journal Owner and Durable Backend Configuration

compose_contract_alignment.details: docker-compose.yml and docker-compose.control.yml updated for operator-bff service to supply GOVERNANCE_STORE_BACKEND (${GOVERNANCE_STORE_BACKEND:-postgres}), GOVERNANCE_STORE_DSN (${GOVERNANCE_STORE_DSN:-${DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://pantheon_app:pantheon_app@postgres:5432/pantheon}}), GOVERNANCE_STORE_BOOTSTRAP (${GOVERNANCE_STORE_BOOTSTRAP:-1}), and PANTHEON_DECISION_JOURNAL_DATA_DIR (${PANTHEON_DECISION_JOURNAL_DATA_DIR:-/data/bff/decision_journal}). Preserves read-only /data/governance:ro volume mount without changing :ro to :rw, routing write authority to PostgreSQL with isolated fallback.

backend_selection_and_legacy_reconciliat.details: services/governance/decision_journal.py implements resolve_decision_journal_backend(): supported backends are 'json' and 'postgres'. When GOVERNANCE_STORE_BACKEND is unset, presence of DATABASE_URL or GOVERNANCE_STORE_DSN selects 'postgres' (never silently defaults to json). Unsupported legacy aliases (e.g. AGORA_GOVERNANCE_STORE_BACKEND='memory' or 'redis') raise ValueError. Conflicting backend combinations (e.g. GOVERNANCE_STORE_BACKEND='json' with AGORA_GOVERNANCE_STORE_BACKEND='postgres') raise ValueError.

fail_closed_storage_honesty.details: services/governance/decision_journal.py enforces that CoordinatingJsonGovernanceRecordStore write operations (put, insert_if_absent, compare_and_set, delete, delete_if_equals) and _BundleFileLock.__enter__ fail closed with PermissionError if the store or underlying filesystem is read-only. DecisionJournalOwnerAdapter exposes is_storage_healthy property reflecting underlying store readiness and permissions.

bff_composition_root_wiring.details: services/control-plane/bff/bootstrap/dependencies.py adds typed decision_journal_write_owner: Optional[DecisionJournalWriteOwner] to AppDependencies dataclass and create_default() factory with concrete type validation. services/control-plane/bff/main.py wires decision_journal_write_owner from AppDependencies to app.state.decision_journal_write_owner and injects it into _agora_router.service._get_journal_write_owner.

restart_parity_and_isolation.details: Fresh DecisionJournalOwnerAdapter instance instantiated on the same data directory reads previously committed entries with exact fidelity. Tenant, actor, idempotency, and CAS isolation are preserved across restarts.
